reasons.A: Short declarative sentences with clipped fragments, no contractions, and a plain, lightly wry stance; it ends on a flat concrete note much as the passage does, with only a touch more self-commentary.
reasons.B: Close rhythm and plain diction, but it stacks fragments ('Not many.' twice) a little thicker than the passage does, and adds figurative touches and a reflective summary the author avoids.
reasons.C: Short sentences, but heavier on rhetorical triads and anaphora, with a more casual register ('I cook for the whole ride') and an emotive closing line that is warmer and more explicit than the author's understatement.
reasons.D: Long, subordinated sentences with semicolons, an abstract, essayistic register and an aphoristic ending; nothing like the author's clipped, concrete plainness.
